annotations.text:
Docked at the bottom, dragged to any height. Lyrics stay on screen, so changing a background never means leaving the song.

Collections sit down the left of the dock, not as tabs — the list grows as they add playlists, and a sidebar takes new rows without reflowing.

Folders are scanned from disk. Playlists are built by the operator and can pull from any folder.
Dragged all the way down it becomes a rail: what is on screen right now, and a handle to pull it back up. Costs about 50px when the operator only needs lyrics.
